description: PM-2a: with a wh40k_ai_plan assigned to both AI seats, the AI deploys from the plan instead of its column formula. The fixture is a Custodes mirror at DEPLOYMENT on crucible_of_battle - a TRIANGULAR zone, which the AI's rectangular collision repair alone cannot honour - and its player-2 units carry the _P2 mirror re-key. Both seats are configured AI and given the SAME plan, authored in the player-1 frame, so player 2 must transform every placement by [44-x, 60-y] to deploy legally at all. Asserts (a) the plan is installed and enabled on both seats, (b) all 22 units deploy, (c) their deployed model positions match the authored ones within 0.5 inch on BOTH seats, (d) the AI's decision records carry the 'plan:<name>' source and the seat_mirrored flag that make adherence countable per seat, and (e) every seat-2 model sits inside the player-2 zone. Screenshots capture the empty board before deployment and the plan-driven formation after.
